blocks.text: VPN Support Information allows you to create VPN diagnostic sessions that run commands on VPN Service Edges, Network Connectors, and Network Connector groups. You can then filter and view the outputs of these diagnostic sessions to assist in troubleshooting.
VPN support information provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View diagnostic command outputs for various VPN components.
Discover and troubleshoot VPN tunnel components for high availability.

blocks.heading: About the VPN Support Information Page

blocks.text: On the VPN Support Information page (Private Access > VPN (for Legacy Apps) > VPN Support Information), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Select the time range to filter the VPN diagnostic sessions. You can select a preset date range, or specify a custom start and end date. If you use the Custom Range option, the start date must be within the last 6 months.

View a list of applied filters available from the current and previous VPN diagnostic sessions (for VPN Service Edges, Network Connectors, and Network Connector groups). Applied filters must be saved to the VPN diagnostic session first before they can be viewed. Use the drop-down menu to select the applied filters to view. To learn more, see Using Tables.
Hide the filters on the page by clicking Hide Filters. Click Show Filters to display the filters.
Refresh the VPN Support Information page to reflect the most current information.

Filter the information that appears in the table. By default, no filters are applied. You can also save applied filters to your preferences so that they're visible in future user sessions. To learn more, see Using Tables.
Add a VPN diagnostic session.

View a list of all deployed VPN diagnostic sessions. By default, the data for all users is displayed for diagnostic sessions that occurred in the last 14 days. For each VPN diagnostic session, you can see:
Sessions: The name of the VPN diagnostic session. When you expand a session, you can see:
The VPN diagnostic session log.
Commands: The command for the diagnostic session.
Number of Lines: The number of command lines set for that VPN diagnostic session.
Time Range: The duration for which the command is run.
Start Time: The time when the VPN diagnostic session starts to run the commands.
End Time: The time when the VPN diagnostic session finishes running the commands.

Status: Displays the status of the VPN diagnostic session (Completed, Failed, Pending, or Processing). Sessions with a Pending or Processing status auto-refresh every 60 seconds to reflect the most current status. Statuses in the VPN Support Information table refresh every 45 seconds.
Modified By: Displays who most recently modified the VPN diagnostic session.
Modify the columns displayed in the table.
Click the Redo icon to open the Edit VPN Session window to edit the configuration of the VPN diagnostic session.
Click the Comment icon to add a comment in the Description window.
Delete a VPN diagnostic session.
Download a JSON file of the VPN diagnostic session results.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
